required: Bring gloves. We supply bags and water.

brief: Design a portrait event poster for a weekly music night. The event name must dominate. The time and place must be readable from across a room.
Design the front of a business card for a landscape designer. The name leads, the title follows, and the contact lines sit together.
Design a one-page A4 impact summary for a food bank. Show three large headline figures, a short paragraph, and a simple bar chart of meals served per quarter.

brief: Design a festival poster. The background is a smooth diagonal gradient between two colors, and a large soft glowing circle sits behind the title. Make the title huge and the details small but readable.
Design a features page on a light gray background with three equal cards that look raised off the page with soft drop shadows. Each card has a heading and a one-line description.
required: Your data never leaves your device.

brief: Design a thank-you card. The background is a repeating pattern of dots or stripes drawn with shapes. The message sits on a solid panel so it stays readable.

Design a bar chart slide of quarterly revenue in thousands of dollars: Q1 is 120, Q2 is 180, Q3 is 150, Q4 is 240. Draw the bars with shapes and make each bar height proportional to its value. Add a baseline, a label under each bar, and the value above each bar.

Design an invoice with a table of line items, a subtotal, 8% tax, and a total. Compute the amounts yourself. Items: Design review, 3 hours at 120.00 each. Print setup, 1 at 85.00. Proofs, 4 at 15.00 each. Align the number columns on the right.
Design a team page with a heading and a grid of twelve equal cards in 4 columns and 3 rows. Rows and columns must line up exactly with equal gaps. Each card shows a two-digit number and a name.

Design a six-page report. Page 1 is a cover. Pages 2 to 6 each have a section title and a short paragraph. Every content page has a page number at the same position in the footer. Keep the grid identical across pages.

Design an event ticket with rounded corners, a dashed perforation line that splits the main part from a narrow stub, a half-circle notch cut at the top and bottom of the perforation, and a barcode made of vertical bars on the stub.
